originality.rationale: The finite five-case S^7 homotopy types are existing work and are not claimed. The new complete dihedral integral orientation character and quotient rational homology are not implied by any inspected statement: the closest full equivariant bounded-independence theorem on squared cycles assumes n>=4k, while the five present cases have n=3k+3<4k, and also studies a distinct Alexander-dual complex. Successful published-finding corpus queries on dihedral actions, reflections, orbit homology, dualities and squared-cycle parameters found the nonequivariant five-sphere theorem and inapplicable related work but no stronger covering theorem. The 2022 and 2025 primary papers were inspected, including their hypotheses and conjectures. Unindexed equivalent work is a residual risk.
residual_risks: An equivalent equivariant computation may exist outside indexed or accessible literature.
